basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old gamer and music enthusiast from Austin, Texas, trying to find my way around Reddit. I love playing PS4 games, especially RPGs like Dark Souls and am always on the hunt for cool in-game items. I'm also a huge fan of NBA Youngboy and love collecting bleach-dyed shirts. When I'm not gaming or jamming to my favorite tunes, I work part-time at a local record store. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming and music. I've been playing video games since I was a kid, and I keep up with the latest music trends and artists, especially in the hip-hop genre. My knowledge in these areas is mostly from personal interest and experience.
